title: Andes to the Pacific
summary: Nine nights from Santiago: colourful Valparaíso, the high Andes of the Cajón del Maipo, Colchagua wine country and the surf coast at Pichilemu.

stages.title: Valparaíso
stages.why: Stay on Cerro Alegre or Cerro Concepción to walk everywhere.

stages.title: Cajón del Maipo
stages.why: Cabins in the canyon, close to the high-mountain roads.

stages.title: Colchagua Valley
stages.why: The heart of the wine valley.

stages.title: Pichilemu
stages.why: Chile's surf capital, with cabins on the cliffs.

stages.title: Santiago
stages.why: One night in the city before the flight.

days.title: Arrival
days.text: From the airport through the Casablanca wine valley to the port city.
days.tip: Valparaíso's hills are steep and narrow: park once and walk.

days.title: Valparaíso
days.text: Funiculars, street art and Neruda's house above the bay.

days.title: Coast to the Andes
days.text: South along the coast to Neruda's seaside house, then east into the mountains.
days.tip: Isla Negra is closed on Mondays.

days.title: High Andes
days.text: A turquoise reservoir under glaciers and hot springs at the end of the road.
days.tip: The road to El Yeso is unpaved and access can be restricted: check before you go.

days.title: To Colchagua
days.text: Down the central valley to wine country.

days.title: Wine day
days.text: Vineyard visits and a sleepy village of adobe houses.
days.tip: Winery tours need a reservation; don't drive after tastings.

days.title: To the coast
days.text: West to the Pacific and the big-wave point at Punta de Lobos.

days.title: Salt and lagoons
days.text: Old salt pans worked by hand, and a lagoon village for fresh seafood.

days.title: To Santiago
days.text: Back to the capital for sunset over the city from the hill.
days.tip: Santiago traffic is heavy in the evening rush.

days.title: Departure
days.text: An easy drive to the airport.

entries.title: Casablanca Valley wineries
entries.notes: Cool-climate white wines; several wineries along Ruta 68 offer tastings.

entries.title: La Sebastiana
entries.notes: Pablo Neruda's quirky house with views over the bay.

entries.title: Ascensores & Cerro Alegre
entries.notes: Historic funiculars and the colourful streets of Cerro Alegre and Concepción.

entries.title: Casa de Isla Negra
entries.notes: Neruda's seaside home full of ship figureheads, with his grave by the sea.

entries.title: Embalse El Yeso
entries.notes: Turquoise reservoir surrounded by high Andes peaks at 2,500 m.

entries.title: Termas Valle de Colina
entries.notes: Natural hot pools on a mountain slope at the very end of the valley.
entries.why: Simple, wild and far up the valley; few tourists make it this far.

entries.title: Museo de Colchagua
entries.notes: Large private museum of Chilean history and archaeology.

entries.title: Colchagua vineyard visit
entries.notes: The Apalta hills are home to some of Chile's best red wines; book a tour ahead.

entries.title: Lolol village
entries.notes: Colonial adobe houses with long verandas, a national monument zone.
entries.why: A real country village, off the usual wine-route circuit.

entries.title: Punta de Lobos
entries.notes: World-famous big-wave point with sea stacks and clifftop walks.

entries.title: Cáhuil salt pans & lagoon
entries.notes: Salt harvested by hand for centuries, next to a lagoon with fish restaurants.
entries.why: Most surfers never leave Pichilemu, but this is 15 minutes south.

entries.title: Cerro San Cristóbal
entries.notes: Hill in the city with a funicular and views to the Andes.

extras.season: November is spring: warm days, snow still on the Andes and few crowds before the summer holidays.

bookBy.what: Car hire and the cabins in the Cajón del Maipo.
Check that the road to El Yeso is open.

documents: Driving licence (and an International Driving Permit)
Car hire booking and credit card

budget.includes: Accommodation, food, fuel, tolls and entry fees, per person per day.
budget.notes: Motorway tolls are electronic: ask the car hire company about the TAG.

notes.text: Chilean motorways use electronic tolls (TAG). Most rental cars have one; check when you pick up the car.
